d56371.title: Scan runtime — URL + credentials
d56371.content:
# Scan runtime — URL + credentials

## URL
http://127.0.0.1:8088 (php artisan serve, exec session id **45158**, tty — do not kill; poll with write_stdin if needed)

## Accounts (role strings matter: `instructor` / `student`, NOT "cadet")
| Role | Username | Password | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instructor | `mharper` | `Vq7tunnel9Ridgeway` | id=1, office LON1A0980, sees Instructor Operations Hub at /dashboard |
| Student (cadet) | `ofletcher` | `Br4ssplate2Sundial` | id=2, approved, Trainee Dashboard |
| Student (cadet) | `pnandra` | `Cedar8Lantern5Frost` | id=3, approved, Trainee Dashboard |

Login is via `username` (NOT email-first; email also accepted) + `password` fields, CSRF token required from GET /login. JSON responses if `Accept: application/json` (401 JSON on bad creds). Unapproved accounts land on /pending-approval.

## DB
- `database/scan.sqlite` — fresh, migrated (`php artisan migrate --force`), seeded (`php artisan db:seed --force`: aircraft/airports/airlines/scenarios/queue items).
- User's original `database/database.sqlite` is UNTOUCHED.
- `storage/installed` lock file existed already (pre-existing, from user's own install at 127.0.0.1:8000) — installer was NOT run; users created via tinker `User::create` with `is_approved=true`.

## Environment
- PHP 8.4.27 CLI installed via apt (php8.4-cli + sqlite3/mbstring/xml/curl/zip/bcmath/intl).
- `.env` modified: `DB_DATABASE=database/scan.sqlite`, `APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8088`. APP_KEY kept from user's .env. APP_ENV=local, APP_DEBUG=true.
- Vite manifest already built at public/build — no npm build needed.
- Laravel 13.38.0.

## Restore to pre-scan state
1. `cp .env.scan-backup .env`
2. `rm database/scan.sqlite` (regenerable; user's database.sqlite untouched)
3. Stop server session 45158
4. (PHP packages installed system-wide via apt — remove with the package names above if desired)

## Verified
- GET / → 200; GET /login → 200
- POST /login instructor → 302 → /dashboard (Instructor Operations Hub, 200)
- POST /login student → 302 → /dashboard (Trainee Dashboard, 200)

09b0de.title: Route→Controller→Sink inventory
09b0de.content:
# Route → Controller → Sink Inventory (Laravel 13, routes/web.php)

Global middleware on ALL routes: `trustProxies(at:'*')`, CSRF (no exceptions), `SecurityHeadersMiddleware` (XFO/nosniff/referrer/permissions + CSP with `'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'` in script-src), `EnsureAppIsInstalled` (installer lock). JSON errors for `api/*`.

## Public (unauthenticated)
| Route | Controller@method | Notes / sinks |
|---|---|---|
| GET `/install` | InstallerController@show | Renders wizard pre-provisioning; uses `$request->getSchemeAndHttpHost()` (trustProxies `*` → Host/XFF-controlled) as default APP_URL |
| POST `/install` | InstallerController@install | Pre-provisioning only (`isAlreadyProvisioned()` gate + install lock `fopen` lock file). Writes `.env` via InstallerService (regex replace), configures DB (attacker-supplied host/port/creds), runs migrations, creates instructor + `Auth::login`. Sinks: `file_put_contents` (.env), PDO connect to arbitrary host (SSRF-ish), `preg_replace` on .env |
| GET `/install/requirements` | InstallerController@requirements | JSON env checks; gated |
| POST `/install/test-db` (throttle 10/min) | InstallerController@testDatabase | **SSRF/port-scan primitive**: attacker-supplied `driver/host/port/database/username/password` → `new PDO("mysql:host={host};port={port}")` with 4s timeout. Has cloud-metadata guards (169.254/16 + IPv4-mapped IPv6 blocked) and generic error messages (no reachability oracle detail). DB name backtick-escaped in `CREATE DATABASE` |
| GET `/` | LandingController@index | Static |
| GET `/access-dashboard` | closure | Redirect logic only |
| GET/POST `/login` (throttle 10/min) | AuthController@showLogin/login | Lookup by username OR email (`orWhere`), bcrypt check, `Auth::login($user, true)` remember-me. Enumeration-resistant error. Rate limit key `login` |
| GET/POST `/register` (throttle 10/min) | AuthController@showRegister/register | Role hardcoded `student`, `is_approved:false`. min:6 password. No captcha |
| GET `/pending-approval` | AuthController@pendingApproval | Static |
| POST `/logout` | AuthController@logout | — |
| GET/POST `/forgot-password` (throttle 6/min) | PasswordResetController | Lookup by email OR username (same generic message). Uses Laravel Password broker + `sendPasswordResetNotification` (reset link uses APP_URL/Host — poisoning candidate via trustProxies `*`) |
| GET `/reset-password/{token}` | showResetPassword | Reflects `?email=` into view (Blade-escaped) |
| POST `/reset-password` (throttle 6/min) | resetPassword | Standard broker reset; min:6 |
| **POST `/api/auth/login|register|forgot-password|reset-password`** | same controllers | Mirror, same throttles |
| **GET/POST `/api/auth/me`** (throttle 60/min, **no auth middleware**) | AuthController@me / logout | `me` degrades to `{'user': null}` for guests; `logout` (POST me) is a **guest-callable logout** — calls `Auth::logout()` + session flush on any unauthenticated POST. CSRF still applies (web group) |
| **POST `/api/terminal/execute`** (throttle 60/min, **no auth middleware**) | TerminalController@execute | **Guest-executable parser**: `$userId = $user?->username ?? 'guest'`. Guests get read-only parser features (ET/TTP rejected) but **surname-search & single-letter index paths bypass user scoping** (see below) |
| GET `/api/training/modules` (no auth) | TrainingController@modules | Static curriculum listing |
| POST `/api/dashboard/validate-syntax` (throttle 60/min, no auth) | DashboardController@validateSyntaxApi | Regex classifier on `command`, echoes back (JSON-encoded) |

## Auth'd (`auth` middleware)
| Route | Controller@method | Sinks / notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET `/dashboard` | DashboardController@index | Role split; explicit `?role=instructor` 403 for students |
| GET `/dashboard/{section}` | DashboardController@section | **Allow-list** both roles: student=[workspace,drills,validator,analytics], instructor=[classroom,students,builder,gradebook,queues,analytics]; others → redirect. No dynamic include |
| POST `/dashboard/switch-role` | DashboardController@switchRole | **Always aborts 403** (hard-locked; no privesc) |
| GET `/terminal` | TerminalController@index | View; unapproved-student redirect |
| POST `/terminal/execute` (throttle 60/min) | TerminalController@execute | Parser; `state.activePnr` shape-normalized; writes TerminalActivityLog |
| POST `/instructor/exit-impersonation` | InstructorController@exitImpersonation | **Behind `auth` only** (not instructor). Reads `impersonated_by_instructor` from session, `Auth::login($instructor)` if role=instructor. Self-terminating: forgets keys first, falls to `/login` otherwise. Not exploitable by non-impersonating students (keys absent) |

## Instructor (`instructor` middleware = EnsureUserIsInstructor → role check)
Web: `/instructor` (index), POST/DELETE `/instructor/students...`, impersonate/approve/reject, DELETE `/instructor/scenarios/{id}`.
API `/api/instructor/*`: studentsApi, storeStudent, destroyStudent, impersonate, **batchStoreStudents** (throttle 5/min), approve/reject, **spectate/{username}** (office-scoped), createScenarioApi, deleteScenario, gradeSubmissionApi (office-scoped via submission->user), broadcastQueueApi, resetSandboxApi (resets all if `target_user_id` null).

## Key sinks summary (static)
- **No** `eval/system/exec/proc_open/unserialize` anywhere in `app/`.
- **No** `DB::raw/whereRaw/orderByRaw` in app code; all Eloquent parameterized. Only raw SQL: installer `CREATE DATABASE` (backtick-escaped, installer-gated) .
- **No** Blade `{!! !!}` in any view; no `x-html`/`v-html` (only `innerHTML` from static icon map in dynamic-popup partial).
- **No** file uploads; no `Storage::` user-facing writes; `response()->file/download` absent.
- File writes: `.env` (installer + AppServiceProvider APP_KEY bootstrap), `storage/installing.lock`, sqlite file creation — all operator/bootstrap paths.
- Mass assignment: all `create()` calls use explicit field lists (role/is_approved hardcoded). `Scenario::create($validated)` in createScenarioApi is instructor-only; `Scenario` model has no `$fillable` restriction but validation allow-lists fields.
- **IDOR candidates (for validation agents)**:
  1. `AmadeusParser.php:2244` (RT single-letter index): `Pnr::orderBy('updated_at','desc')->limit(50)` — **no user_id/office scope for ANY role** → cadet lists other cadets' PNR index (names + locators) cross-office.
  2. `AmadeusParser.php:2290` (RT surname search): scope applied ONLY `if (! $isInstructor && $userId !== 'guest')` — guests skip the scope entirely (moot, guest can't store) but **students ARE scoped**; instructors read all (by design, but cross-office leak for multi-academy shared host).
  3. `AmadeusParser.php:2352` (RT 6/12-char locator): ownership check present BUT `&& $userId !== 'guest'` — **guest path loads any PNR by locator into state and displays it** (no log write for guest though). Requires knowing locator (6 chars, 36^6).
  4. `getActivePnrApi` ?user= — instructor-only branch, office-scoped. OK.
- Parser writes PNR via `Pnr::updateOrCreate(['record_locator'], ...)` with `lockForUpdate` + overwrite protection for non-instructors. Instructor overwrite of any PNR is by-design.
- TerminalActivityLog: unbounded per-user insert on every command (throttle 60/min caps it); DB growth DoS is low.
- `saveProgress` (TrainingController): objectives re-verified server-side against own terminal logs — no trust-the-client grading. Good control.

931c0b.title: IDOR analysis: 3 reported findings + clean-surface ledger (static+dynamic)
931c0b.content:
# IDOR analysis: object map + confirmed findings (static + dynamic)

## REPORTED (vuln-0005/0006/0007)
1. **vuln-0005 (medium, CVSS 5.3)** — Unauthenticated PNR disclosure: `/api/terminal/execute` allows guest identity; RT-locator ownership check at AmadeusParser.php:2354 exempts `$userId === 'guest'` → no-session callers read ANY stored PNR by 6-char locator; surname search (:2288) same exemption → list+auto-retrieve. Guest also writes foreign-office queue rows via QE/<office> (:2457). Exchanges: 296 (guest read) vs 292 (cadet blocked control). Fix: 401 in TerminalController + drop guest exemptions.
2. **vuln-0006 (medium, CVSS 4.3)** — Cross-cadet PNR disclosure: single-letter index `RT/S` (AmadeusParser.php:2237-2240) loads 50 latest PNRs with NO scoping for any role (surname branch right below scopes students); `RT<LINE>` (:2195) then returns full foreign PNR from leaked lastPnrList, no check. Exchanges: 211 (leak) → 212 (full PNR) vs 292 (direct RT blocked). Fix: mirror surname-branch scoping.
3. **vuln-0007 (low, CVSS 2.7)** — Cross-instructor scenario delete: DELETE /api/instructor/scenarios/{id} has role check only; ScenarioService::deleteScenario cascades ALL students' submissions; scenarios have no office column. Live: XOFF22 instructor deleted LON1A0980 instructor's scenario + its submission (exchanges 240/244/245/246). Every sibling instructor op IS office-scoped. Fix: creator check before delete.

## Clean (named controls, live-verified where noted)
- RT<locator> for authed cadets: RT_UNAUTHORIZED (exchange 292). ET overwrite: blocked (:1898). TTP foreign: blocked (:2389). IR: own/instructor only (:1944). Guest-gated: ET/TTP/QS/QD.
- Submissions/progress: submitScenarioApi grades own stored PNR only (422 control, exchange 200); saveProgress/progress strictly own-username, server re-verifies objectives against own logs; gradeSubmissionApi office-scoped (:487-491).
- Instructor boundaries: approve/reject/destroy/impersonate/spectate all office-scoped (live 404s cross-office); sandbox reset office-scoped (verified row counts); broadcast takes office from session.
- getActivePnrApi: student ?user= ignored; instructor target office-checked.
- /dashboard/{section}: strict allow-lists; gradebook → 302 for cadets.
- Auxiliary retrieval (RT flight/ticket, LM/LP, LPO/LPS, RO): hardcoded demo data only.

## Residual observations (not reported)
- state.officeId fully client-controlled (blade JS default 'LON1A0980'): queue read/write trust it → covered in vuln-0005 remediation; ET also stores client office on PNR rows.
- Same-office instructor can spectate another instructor (no role filter in spectate lookup) — single-academy trust model.
- Same-office classroom reset clears colleagues' queue items — role-consistent.

## Object map
User(id PK, username, office_id) | Pnr(pk=record_locator, user_id→username, office_id) | Scenario(pk string, created_by, NO office) | Submission(uuid, user_id, scenario_id) | LessonProgress(user_id+lesson_id) | QueueItem(uuid, office_id, target_user_id nullable) | TerminalActivityLog(uuid, user_id, no office).

## Dynamic env
http://127.0.0.1:8088, scan.sqlite; creds in note d56371. PoC: /workspace/amadus/poc_idor_58e94365.py (phases main/phase2/phase3). Test instructor cross_inst/Ridge9Cedar2Tunnel office XOFF22 was added to scan.sqlite (scan-only DB, not user's).

84823b.title: Injection sweep (SQL + output) — no reachable sink
84823b.content:
Injection-focused agent (SQL + output injection) completed static + dynamic sweep on /workspace/amadus (runtime http://127.0.0.1:8088). **No reachable injection sink found.**

SQL: zero raw-expression builders in app/; all Eloquent bound params. DecodeService LIKE uses addcslashes('%_') + binding. Installer CREATE DATABASE is ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$ + backtick-doubled + install-gated. Dynamic probes (quotes, UNION, || concatenation in DAC/RT paths) — literal handling, no SQL errors/diffs.

Output injection: zero {!! !!} / x-html in any Blade view. All user data renders via {{ }} or x-text. @json uses Laravel Js::from (JSON_HEX_TAG): PNR free-text payloads containing </script><script>... stored via SSR/AP/RM/RF and rendered as \u003C\/SCRIPT\u003E inside the inline script — no breakout; downstream all x-text. /api/instructor/spectate returns raw '<' in JSON but is instructor-auth-gated (guest 401) and its only consumer (dashboard/instructor.blade.php spectate modal) renders via x-text. dynamic-popup innerHTML = static icon map only. No eval/exec/file sinks reachable from parser commands; NM names reject '<'; no pipe/redirect/macro semantics in parser dispatch (69 str_starts_with branches).

Payload scripts at /workspace/inj/{login.py,payloads.py} + stored marker PNR (rloc 3NGTU2, user ofletcher) — markers ZZXSSZZ in SSR text / AP detail / RM text / RF. Future agents can reuse for render-path checks.

5b3fdd.title: Installer surface: complete — 1 finding filed (vuln-0008), fix applied
5b3fdd.content:
Installer surface analysis (agent b637cfa2) — complete. All work done on isolated copy at port 8099; shared 8088 untouched (briefly killed by broad pkill during lab cleanup and restarted; lock self-healed from DB with real instructor mharper — itself confirming the lock defense).

FINDING (filed vuln-0008, medium 6.5, confidence high, fix applied + verified): POST /install/test-db (unauthenticated, pre-lock window) — (1) link-local guard bypass: hex `0xa9fea9fe`, octal `0177.0.0.1`, trailing-dot `169.254.169.254.` pass `FILTER_VALIDATE_IP`+gethostbyname check but MySQL client resolves them → TCP connect to 169.254.169.254:3306 proven via listener log; (2) timing port-scan oracle: closed port 422 in ~0.04s vs open port hang; (3) worker-exhaustion DoS: silent-open port pins PDO past ATTR_TIMEOUT indefinitely (mysqlnd read unbounded) — one request wedged the single-worker artisan-serve deployment. Fix in app/Services/Installer/InstallerService.php (lines ~219-270): fail-closed resolution + DSN pinned to resolved dotted IP + 2s fsockopen pre-flight + 2s first-handshake-byte read. Verified: all bypass forms blocked, silent-open bounded at 2.05s, real MariaDB full install still succeeds end-to-end, 169/169 tests pass.

RULED OUT (controls verified live, coverage recorded): installer lock bypass (flock + self-healing middleware + isAlreadyProvisioned DB fallback; GET/POST /install and test-db all 403/302 when locked, incl. after manual lock deletion with instructor present); .env injection (vendored phpdotenv multiline parser re-joins quoted newlines — APP_DEBUG/APP_KEY/SESSION_DRIVER flip impossible, tested against real parser incl. preg_replace update path and trailing-backslash edge); sqlite database_path traversal (basename-confined); CLI/web lock mismatch (same markInstalled artifact); createInstructor ATO on re-opened installer (refuses existing username/email). Host-header prefill of installer app_url field (X-Forwarded-Host reflected in wizard) noted as no_issue_found — display-only, operator must complete install.
